R1.a_metric_precision_recall_or_cost_bal.where_in_r1_card: Metric Shape And Degeneracy Controls / Balanced Metric Requirement; Acceptance Gate; Stop Condition
R1.a_metric_precision_recall_or_cost_bal.notes: Requires precision+recall, stated F-beta, cost-weighted utility, or another balanced metric; forbids recall-only, precision-only, coverage-only, specificity-only, abstention-only, and size-only metrics; maps violation to rejected_metric_degenerate.

R1.a_predict_all_predict_none_constant_k.where_in_r1_card: Full Baseline Panel; Metric Shape And Degeneracy Controls / Degenerate Predictor Controls; Acceptance Gate
R1.a_predict_all_predict_none_constant_k.notes: Requires predict_all, predict_none, constant_k_sweep, random, and majority as callable baseline rows with producer/provenance and consumed_by_final_verdict=true.

R1.a_size_only_sweep.where_in_r1_card: Metric Shape And Degeneracy Controls / Size-Only Sweep; Acceptance Gate; Stop Condition
R1.a_size_only_sweep.notes: Requires 0..N size-only sweep with content policy fixed or matched; rejects if size alone reaches ceiling band.

R1.a_metric_controls_consumed_by_final_v.where_in_r1_card: Metric Shape And Degeneracy Controls / Control Consumption; Computed-Evidence Provenance Gate; Acceptance Gate
R1.a_metric_controls_consumed_by_final_v.notes: States computed but unconsumed metric-degeneracy controls invalidate the bundle and cannot support an admissibility verdict.

R1.b_partial_inferability_demonstration.where_in_r1_card: Positive Admission Basis / Partial-Inferability Demonstration; Acceptance Gate; Stop Condition
R1.b_partial_inferability_demonstration.notes: Requires passive non-triviality, non-independence from fair channels, residual uncertainty, and fair legal channel reducibility with passive-only, decodability, marginal, and null-oracle controls.

R1.b_budget_faithful_visible_channel_ora.where_in_r1_card: Positive Admission Basis / Budget-Faithful Visible-Channel Oracle; Acceptance Gate; Stop Condition
R1.b_budget_faithful_visible_channel_ora.notes: Requires any admissive oracle to be budget-faithful, visible-channel only, legal-access only, not answer-key based, and to clear strongest fair baseline by the equivalence band.

R1.c_surface_spec_independent_frozen_aut.where_in_r1_card: Surface Specification Authorship And Immutability; Observable State; Acceptance Gate
R1.c_surface_spec_independent_frozen_aut.notes: Requires surface spec to exist before implementation and be authored/frozen by separate authority or accepted pre-existing artifact, with path, sha256, source, freeze timestamp or decision-log pointer, and canonical readback channel.

R1.c_block_missing_or_implementer_author.where_in_r1_card: Surface Specification Authorship And Immutability; Stop Condition; Allowed verdicts
R1.c_block_missing_or_implementer_author.notes: Maps missing independent spec to blocked_missing_candidate_free_surface_spec and implementer-authored or mutated spec to blocked_candidate_authored_or_mutated_surface_spec.
